description: Free. Pre-trade rug check for one new memecoin: a Solana mint (a mint or a pump.fun/gmgn/solscan/birdeye link) or a Robinhood Chain pons curve or token address (0x + 40 hex, or its ponsfamily.com/launchpad link). A pump.fun mint inside our live window gets the full check; any other SPL or Token-2022 mint gets a thin on-chain answer (authorities, Token-2022 extensions, supply, the ten largest token accounts, the venue; verdict caution | no_flags_observed_on_chain, never avoid on that evidence). Returns verdict (avoid | caution | no_flags_observed by the fixed public rule, the same word the paid verdict and rhc_curve_card give; null when the token is not covered), reason {code, text} (the first rule that fired), coverage (full | thin | not_covered, with coverage_reason), age_s and next: the paid detail (verdict $0.01 and mint_risk_card $0.025 for pump.fun, rhc_curve_card $0.02 for pons) and the free record page. No odds, holder shares or market figures; no_flags_observed is not a safety verdict. 30 calls per hour per client. Use it first on any token you are about to buy, then pay for the evidence when the word matters.

token.description: The token to check. Solana: a mint or a pump.fun/gmgn/solscan/birdeye link (a base58 SPL or Token-2022 mint, 32-44 chars; a link is resolved to its mint). Robinhood Chain: a pons v2 curve or token address (0x + 40 hex), or its pons link (www.ponsfamily.com/launchpad/<token>) or explorer link (robinhoodchain.blockscout.com/token/<token>).

name: token_check
title: Free pre-trade rug check (any Solana token, pons on Robinhood Chain)
